About this report

  • Period: 2025 (1 Jan – 31 Dec 2025), compared with 2024 (1 Jan – 31 Dec 2024, the same period a year earlier).
  • Data-only report. Built automatically from Search Console and Google Analytics. It has no written commentary.
  • Sources: Google Search Console (search), Google Analytics 4 (organic traffic), saved crawlmark audits, the Chrome UX Report and Google Tag Manager when those sections are included.
  • Traffic by channel: Google Analytics 4, all sessions on the site's own hostnames (not only search), in GA4's default channel groups, compared with the same dates a year earlier.
  • Search clicks by page type: Search Console, filtered by page address; each page counts in the first matching type, and the rest is "Other".
  • Content by publish year: publish dates from each page's structured data, article meta tags or a year in its address, read from the newest saved site crawl; modification dates are never used.
  • Wins and misses: fixed thresholds, listed in that section.
